WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    orderslink,
    AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY orderslink
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS overall_avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM fees
)
SELECT
  AVG(p.avg_rebtotal) AS mean_avg_total_rebate,
  AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_avg_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate - o.overall_avg_net_fee_rate) AS mean_excess_net_fee_rate
FROM per_order AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > o.overall_avg_net_fee_rate;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average net fee rate is the average of all non-NULL row-level (feerate - rebrate) values in fees; the NULL orderslink group is included when calculating per-order averages and when selecting qualifying groups.
